text.en: After lunch Raju asked, "Where does my food go?" His teacher drew a long tube from the mouth to the anus.

Digestion is the breakdown of large, insoluble food molecules into small, soluble, diffusible ones by digestive enzymes. The alimentary canal is the passage from the mouth to the anus. Teeth are of different types, and the dental formula shows how many of each type are in one half of each jaw.
The small intestine is the longest part of the canal, about 5 to 7 metres, and has the duodenum, jejunum and ileum, where digested food is absorbed. The liver and pancreas pour their juices into it to help digestion.
The excretory system removes waste from the body, with the kidneys filtering the blood to make urine. The reproductive system, which is different in males and females, produces the new generation.

problem.en: Which is the longest part of the small intestine?

text.en: The small intestine has three parts.
They are duodenum, jejunum and ileum.
The ileum is the longest part.

prompt.en: A friend says Absorption of digested food mainly happens in the stomach. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Most absorption happens in the small intestine.
Its long coiled shape gives a large surface.

points.en: Digestion makes food small and soluble.
The alimentary canal runs from mouth to anus.
